title: Relationship Expectations
summary: Expectations are what each person assumes about time, commitment, exclusivity, money, family roles and the future. Unspoken expectations cause many conflicts, so talking about them early helps.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
